NAME: Cidra
LINE: The nobility is so obsessed with standing in the sun, never realizing how much darker the rot grows beneath their feet... don't you think?

NAME: Russel
LINE: That voice... Cidra?

NAME: Odessa
LINE: It can't be. Your family buried you two winters ago.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: They buried an empty coffin. I hope the black suited you, Odessa.

NAME: Odessa
LINE: You let us mourn you. Do you have any idea what that did to all of us?

NAME: Russel
LINE: It doesn't matter now. You're alive. Come back to the estate, Cidra. Your family will welcome you home.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: Will they? High society has had plenty to mourn lately. Lord Halvere last night. Baron Corve the week before.

NAME: Russel
LINE: Terrible business. All the more reason for you to return to our circle where it's safe.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: Safe for a lady... or safe for a lord?

NAME: Odessa
LINE: Stop pretending, Russel. You know exactly what she is telling you.

NAME: Odessa
LINE: Every one of them dined in our parlors, Cidra. They were pillars of our circle—men I still have to smile at.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: And behind closed doors, those same pillars decided what I would wear, who I would wed, and what I was forced to endure.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: A noble title isn't a shield for a woman, Odessa. It's a prettier collar—and I simply stopped wearing mine.

NAME: Odessa
LINE: Don't. Don't you dare make it mean nothing.

NAME: Odessa
LINE: I bled for every curtsey I ever made in those parlors. If our rank is rot, then so is everything I survived to keep mine.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: Then wake up, Odessa... You smile at those vipers and call your silence survival!

NAME: Cidra
LINE: You are a product of our noble society... yet at least you are not as rotten as the men who preyed on us in the dark and deserved every blade they got!

NAME: Russel
LINE: Cidra... please...

NAME: Cidra
LINE: You still haven't learned how glorious my work was last night, have you?

NAME: Odessa
LINE: Last night? Nobody told the court when Lord Halvere was decapitated! You were there... YOU KNEW!

NAME: Russel
LINE: I found him myself. He was still clutching a scrap of her mother's lace.

NAME: Cidra
LINE: And he said nothing...

NAME: Cidra
LINE: ...all to protect the dearly beloved he thought he saw beneath that murderous cloak.

NAME: Odessa
LINE: Turning you in and ruining you is all I have left of our rivalry, Cidra.

NAME: Odessa
LINE: Yet winning like that would be beneath us both, and I know too well why those men had to fall.

NAME: Russel
LINE: ...Since when do you two agree on anything?!

NAME: Russel
LINE: Cidra... keeping your secret is all I have left of you. May heaven forgive me for it.
